headline: Better built-in mods, compact menus, and Minecraft 1.26.45 support
summary: This update improves built-in mods and overlays, adds a more compact Mod Menu layout, and updates compatibility for Minecraft 1.26.45.

items.text: Added Minecraft 1.26.45 support to built-in mods.
Improved AutoSprint with a more reliable native sprint implementation.
Improved Quick Drop so holding the button continuously drops items.
Built-in overlay button opacity can now be lowered all the way to 0%.
Added Compact Mode with a cleaner layout for the Mod Menu.
Removed the long-press resize and opacity editor from built-in overlay buttons.
Updated the changelog dialog layout for a better experience across different screen sizes.
